job.title: [Post] We're Hiring | Salesforce Commerce Cloud Developer – Associate L2 Innova is looking for…

tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Developer | Java, Spring & API Integration | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms, RESTful APIs and headless integrations for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, SQL, microservices, and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and agile teamwork. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] We're Hiring | Salesforce Commerce Cloud Developer – Associate L2
cover_en.hook: Innova ESI's focus on scalable enterprise web solutions closely aligns with my technical background. With over 5 years of professional experience building and integrating large-scale e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in backend architecture, headless REST APIs, and digital storefront solutions.

bullets.label: Storefront & API Architecture
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for robust custom data flows.

bullets.label: JavaScript & Web Integration
bullets.text: Built RESTful APIs and web services supporting Progressive Web Application (PWA) frontends, ensuring seamless integration between backend services and web storefront interfaces.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integration
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized high-volume data pipelines using Hotfolders and DataHub to keep product catalogs and customer account structures synchronized across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Performance & Delivery
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, while executing CI/CD deployment cycles within agile DevOps workflows.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with a final working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my e-commerce and API integration expertise can contribute to Innova ESI.

tailoring.why_company: Innova ESI stands out for its commitment to delivering innovative e-commerce solutions and robust digital storefront architectures. I want to bring my 5+ years of enterprise platform and API integration experience to help scale your digital commerce initiatives.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated to apply my 5+ years of e-commerce architecture and API integration expertise to build high-performance digital storefront solutions at Innova ESI.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce development, headless REST APIs, and robust platform integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in Innova ESI. My CV and cover letter are ready—let's connect to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – [Post] We're Hiring | Salesforce Commerce Cloud Developer – Associate L2 – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the [Post] We're Hiring | Salesforce Commerce Cloud Developer – Associate L2 position at Innova ESI. With over 5 years of professional experience building large-scale enterprise e-commerce platforms, RESTful APIs, and data integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong technical capabilities in backend engineering and headless web architectures.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available starting 16 December 2026. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
